clauses.use: SourceInformationRecord, PerceptualSupportRecord, and ExplicitDisposition project to declared Entity subtypes.
Each outcome/activity pair has one identified generation event.
Each Core GenerationBinding has one identified usage; repeated use remains distinct.
Each binding projects to an identified expanded derivation citing generated entity, used entity, activity, generation, and usage.
GeneratorManifest projects to SoftwareAgent and each projected Activity has an identified association.

clauses.use: Deterministic qualified identifiers and the closed attribute allowlist.
Deterministic PROV-N document, namespace, QName, typed literal, and expression syntax.

clauses.use: Qualified Usage, Generation, Derivation, and Association RDF structures, including prov:entity, prov:activity, prov:agent, prov:hadUsage, prov:hadGeneration, and prov:hadActivity.
An expanded derivation's referenced usage and generation must exist and match its activity and entities.
Statements sharing an identified relation identifier must unify consistently.
A projected Entity cannot have two distinct generation events.
Entity, Activity, Agent, and influence relation typing must not conflict.
Generation or usage identifiers cannot be supplied on a derivation whose activity is unspecified.
